name: Suzuki T500 Titan
engine: 492 cc air-cooled two-stroke twin, two carbs, oil injection
intro: Suzuki's big two-stroke twin. Crank seals and the gearbox oil level are the big worries.

add.title: Leak-down test the crankcase
add.instructions: Seal the ports and pressure test at about 6-8 psi to check the crank seals.
add.reason: Old crank seals dry out and make it run lean.

H: Early T500s had too little gearbox oil. Suzuki's bulletin T-3 raised it from 1200cc to 1400cc. Use the higher level.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Gearbox oil
known.what: Suzuki raised the oil capacity from 1200cc to 1400cc to stop early 4th and 5th gear failures.
